units.title: 帮户贴役：以世应为主、官鬼为凭；将役扳人忌应空，六冲无鬼彼难从，应爻克世他无咎，鬼落空亡讼若风；欲求帮户须观应与官爻，应若空亡师来帮贴，世遭应克无力扳他，若卜六冲决难遂意、如无官鬼岂得扳人，鬼象临空临绝官心无主无为

rule.yi: 要把自己的役扳到别人身上（求帮户），以世爻、应爻为主，以官鬼为凭据。把役扳给别人，忌讳应爻落空；六冲又没有官鬼，对方难以服从；应爻克世爻，他没有过错；官鬼落空亡，官司就像风一样（落空）。想求得帮户，必须看应爻和官爻：应爻如果空亡，「师来帮贴」；世爻被应爻克制，没有力量去扳他；如果卜得六冲，一定难以遂意；没有官鬼，怎么能扳到人？官鬼的象临空、临绝，官的心里没有主意，不会有作为。
rule.en: To shift a service onto others and so seek help from another household, take the Self and the Other as the chief and Pressure as the ground. In passing the service on to another, the Other being Void is to be avoided; with a six-clash and no Pressure the other party finds it hard to comply; if the Other controls the Self, he is not at fault; if Pressure falls on Void, the lawsuit is like the wind. To seek a helper household one must look at the Other and the Pressure line: if the Other is Void, 'the master comes to help with a subsidy'; if the Self is controlled by the Other, one has no strength to drag him in; if a six-clash is cast it will surely be hard to achieve one's wish; with no Pressure how can one drag another in? If the Pressure image meets Void or extinction, the official's mind has no direction and he does nothing.

yi: 以世爻、应爻为主要看的，以官鬼为凭据。
en: Take the Self and the Other as the chief to be looked at, and Pressure as the ground.

zh: 将役扳人忌应空，六冲无鬼彼难从，
应爻克世他无咎，鬼落空亡讼若风。
yi: 把役扳到别人身上，忌讳应爻落空；六冲又没有官鬼，对方难以服从；
应爻克世爻，他没有过错；官鬼落空亡，官司就像风一样。
en: In passing the service on to another, the Other being Void is to be avoided; with a six-clash and no Pressure the other party finds it hard to comply;
if the Other controls the Self, he is not at fault; if Pressure falls on Void, the lawsuit is like the wind.

zh: 欲求帮户，须观应与官爻，应若空亡，师来帮贴。
若卜六冲决难遂意，如无官鬼岂得扳人？
鬼象临空临绝，官心无主无为。
yi: 想求得帮户，必须看应爻和官爻；应爻如果空亡，「师来帮贴」。
世爻被应爻克制，就没有力量去扳他。
如果卜得六冲，一定难以遂意；如果没有官鬼，怎么能扳到人？
官鬼的象临到空、绝，官的心里没有主意，不会有所作为。
en: To seek a helper household one must look at the Other and the Pressure line: if the Other is Void, 'the master comes to help with a subsidy'.
If the Self is controlled by the Other, one has no strength to drag him in.
If a six-clash is cast it will surely be hard to achieve one's wish; with no Pressure how can one drag another in?
If the Pressure image meets Void or extinction, the official's mind has no direction and he does nothing.

note.yi: 「帮户」是协助承担户役的户，「帮贴」「津贴」是补贴费用；「将役扳人」是把役扳到别人身上，让他一起分担。「扳」是攀扯、扳累。「师来帮贴」文字疑有误，按上下文（前面「应空」是忌）似应是没有人来帮贴；这里按字面译。「讼若风」按文意是官司落空、没有结果，书里没有展开。「官心无主」的「官」是承办的官。
note.en: 'Banghu' is a household that helps to bear a household's service, and 'bangtie' and 'jintie' are subsidising the expense; 'jiang yi ban ren' is dragging another person into the service so that he shares it. 'Ban' is to pull in and to saddle. 'Shi lai bangtie' looks wrong in its characters, and by the context (the earlier 'the Other Void' is a taboo) it should presumably mean that no one comes to help with a subsidy; it is translated literally here. 'Song ruo feng' is by the sense a lawsuit coming to nothing, and the book does not go into it. The 'guan' of 'guan xin wu zhu' is the official who handles the matter.

units.title: 帮户贴役：应被世伤官鬼克决能扳累获全功，卦爻生合妻财旺定来贴费两和同，应上临官临月破斯人受责受其凶；世克应爻或官伤应位必是如心，世应相生相合财逢生旺之乡不必官扳自然津贴，官爻值应或应临月破者官必佥帮违选遭责

rule.yi: 应爻被世爻伤、被官鬼克，一定能把役扳累过去，获得全功；卦爻相生相合、妻财旺相，一定来贴补费用，双方和同；应爻上临官爻、临月破，这个人受责、遭凶。世克应爻，或者官伤应位，必定如意；世应相生相合、财爻逢生旺之乡，不必官府来扳，自然来津贴；官爻值应、或者应临月破的，官府一定佥派帮户，违背选定的就遭责罚。
rule.en: If the Other is hurt by the Self and controlled by Pressure, one can surely drag the service onto the other and gain complete success; if the lines generate and combine and Wealth is thriving, they will surely come with a subsidy for the expenses and both sides will be in accord; if the Other rests on the star of office or on Month-break, that man is reproved and meets ill. If the Self controls the Other line, or the star of office hurts the Other's place, it will surely be as one wishes; if the Self and the Other generate and combine with each other and Wealth meets a place of generation and thriving, there is no need for the officials to drag anyone in, and a subsidy comes of itself; if the Pressure line is on the Other, or the Other rests on Month-break, the officials will surely assign helper households, and whoever goes against the selection is reproved.

zh: 应被世伤官鬼克，决能扳累获全功，
卦爻生合妻财旺，定来贴费两和同。
应上临官临月破，斯人受责受其凶。
yi: 应爻被世爻伤、被官鬼克，一定能把役扳累过去，获得全功；
卦爻相生相合、妻财旺相，一定来贴补费用，双方和同；
应爻上临官爻、临月破，这个人受责、遭凶。
en: If the Other is hurt by the Self and controlled by Pressure, one can surely drag the service onto the other and gain complete success;
if the lines generate and combine and Wealth is thriving, they will surely come with a subsidy for the expenses and both sides will be in accord;
if the Other rests on the star of office or on Month-break, that man is reproved and meets ill.

zh: 世克应爻或官伤应位，必是如心。
世应相生相合、财逢生旺之乡不必官扳，自然津贴。
官爻值应或应临月破者，官必佥帮违选遭责。
yi: 世克应爻，或者官伤应位，必定如意。
世应相生相合、财爻逢生旺之乡，不必官府来扳，自然来津贴。
官爻值应、或者应临月破的，官府一定佥派帮户，违背选定的就遭责罚。
en: If the Self controls the Other line, or the star of office hurts the Other's place, it will surely be as one wishes.

If the Self and the Other generate and combine with each other and Wealth meets a place of generation and thriving, there is no need for the officials to drag anyone in, and a subsidy comes of itself.
If the Pressure line is on the Other, or the Other rests on Month-break, the officials will surely assign helper households, and whoever goes against the selection is reproved.

note.yi: 「扳累」是把累赘攀扯到别人身上；「贴费」是补贴费用。「斯人」指应（被扳的一方）：解里「官爻值应或应临月破者，官必佥帮违选遭责」说的是同一件事，「违选」按文意是违背官府的选定。「官伤应位」「官必佥帮」书里没有展开。
note.en: 'Banlei' is saddling another with a burden; 'tiefei' is subsidising the expense. 'Siren', that man, is the Other (the party who is dragged in): the explanation's 'if the Pressure line is on the Other or the Other rests on Month-break, the officials will surely assign helper households and whoever goes against the selection is reproved' speaks of the same thing, and 'wei xuan' is by the sense going against the authorities' selection. 'The star of office hurts the Other's place' and 'the officials will surely assign helpers' are not unfolded in the book.
